verdict.rationale: Vanta treats ISO 27001 as a dedicated framework: it has its own product page claiming it helps you certify, offers AI-powered ISMS templates for roles, responsibilities and risks, and is named on the homepage alongside SoC 2. Generic audit tooling (an Auditor API covering audits, controls, evidence and information requests) supports certification engagements. However, nothing in the evidence documents the current Annex A control set or a Statement of Applicability, so 'first-class beyond mapping' is only partly shown. Missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
